verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents outbound JSON webhooks for Payments API v3 events, such as payment status changes. You register them as a webhook URI per app in Console, and each one carries a verifiable Tl-Signature, so a programmatic consumer can subscribe and receive events. Missing for 10: support for more than one webhook URI per app (only a single URI is allowed), evidence of per-event-type subscription filtering or API-based (non-Console) registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks are JSON-format notifications you receive when any event occurs within the Payments API v3.
Each of your apps in Console can have a single webhook URI, which the Payments API sends webhooks to.
webhooks inform you about: when a payment changes to a new status in the authorisation process
You must validate all incoming webhook requests through the `Tl-Signature` that accompanies the webhook.
